title: Subscription checkout journey (synthetic)

provenance: SYNTHETIC journey: stage order and timestamps are authored. Verbatim TEST-split rows: #511 (benign), #129 (scarcity), #69 (social_proof), #547 (benign), #565 (benign), #64 (social_proof), #651 (urgency), #525 (benign), #650 (benign), #474 (misdirection), #612 (misdirection). AUTHORED: checkout markup/CSS, the second countdown reading 'OFFER ENDS 00:58:40' (to demonstrate reset detection against the cart reading 00:54:59 taken 9 minutes earlier), the pre-ticked 'Add shipping protection for $4.99', the accept labels 'Claim discount and continue' and 'Yes, keep my membership', and the declared 1-vs-5 step cancellation path.
